_comment: Pinned Temurin (Eclipse Adoptium) JDK 21 for the bundled Ghidra runtime. This file is the trust anchor for the download: packaging/stage.ps1 fetches the exact url below and refuses to proceed unless its SHA-256 matches sha256 here. The url is an immutable GitHub release asset, so the build is reproducible. To bump: pick a newer Temurin 21 GA release, update every field from the Adoptium assets API (https://api.adoptium.net/v3/assets/latest/21/hotspot?os=windows&architecture=x64&image_type=jdk&vendor=eclipse), and commit.
